metadata.label: C1 strict formation ablation
metadata.comparison: C1 cooperative minus H transform: negative time/fuel means C1 is lower
metadata.interpretation: C1 and H both suppress ordinary overtaking in lane-drop organized modes; H-minus-C1 contrasts formation following and layer fill under unchanged cooperation. A numerical contrast alone does not prove that physically formed groups caused it.
metadata.straight_proof: Inherited bound C0 actual proof; exact full-NOA delegation branch unchanged; no repeated short runs

frozen_analysis_source.changes: cooperative enum/label only; no evaluation formula or threshold changes; no runtime monkeypatch
